description: National Medicines Regulatory Authority - Amendment, The Pricing of Medical Devices Regulations, No. 01 of 2020, Published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2160/28 of January 29, 2020
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, specifically amending pricing regulations for medical devices. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for medical device pricing and export controls, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
